title: Xanthe and the Echo
author: Rafael Thornbury
blurb: Oscar Villalobos, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
